# Infralicious

> Small, honest software for teams. TrueTime for Jira: Forge-native timesheets.
> Links below point at raw markdown versions. HTML versions live at https://infralicious.com/ with the same paths.

## Products

- [TrueTime for Jira](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/truetime/index.md): Forge-native timesheets for Jira. One-click timers, weekly timesheets, approvals, Tempo CSV import. Free for up to 10 users, $2.99 per user per month above that. Currently in beta.

## Documentation

- [TrueTime User Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/truetime/user-guide.md): Log time, approvals, teams, admin settings.
- [Migrate from Tempo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/truetime/migration.md): Move Tempo history to TrueTime with a CSV export.
- [TrueTime API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/truetime/api.md): Create time entries with the Jira REST API.
- [TrueTime Support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/truetime/support.md): How to get help.

## Company

- [About](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/about.md): Infralicious builds small, honest software for teams.

- [Support SLA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/sla.md): Support hours and response targets.
- [Privacy Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/privacy.md): Company privacy policy.

- [TrueTime Terms of Service](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infralicious/infralicious.github.io/main/truetime/terms.md): TrueTime license and tiers.
